blocks.tamil_translation: whoever protects the honour and dignity of a Muslim, on the Day of Qiyamah Allah Ta'ala will appoint an angel. He will protect his flesh (his body) from the fire of Jahannam. And whoever slanders a Muslim in order to disgrace him, Allah Ta'ala will keep him standing on the bridge of Jahannam until (he receives punishment and) becomes purified from (the filth of) his slander.” Hazrat Mu'adh ibn Anas al-Juhani (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ يَزِيْدَ ﵂ قَالَتْ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ ذَبَّ عَنْ عِرْضِ اَخِيْهِ بِالْغَيْبَةِ كَانَ حَقًّا عَلَي اللهِ اَنْ يُعْتِقَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه احمد والطبراني واسناد احمد حسن، مجمع الزوائد:٨ /١٧٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever stops talk about a Muslim brother in his absence that harms his honour and dignity (such as stopping backbiting), it becomes an obligation upon Allah Ta'ala to free him from the Fire.” Hazrat Asma bint Yazid (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ رَدَّ عَنْ عِرْضِ اَخِيْهِ الْمُسْلِمِ كَانَ حَقًّا عَلَي اللهِ اَنْ يَرُدَّ عَنْهُ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever stands up to defend the honour and dignity of a Muslim brother, Allah Ta'ala will take upon Himself the responsibility of removing the fire of Jahannam from him on the Day of Qiyamah.” Hazrat Abu Darda (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ:
